payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information about the state-of-the-art system in the context of Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD), specifically mentioning the use of BERT-based models that outperform previous methods.

claims.text: The state-of-the-art system for Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) is based on BERT, which has been fine-tuned to achieve new results on benchmark datasets.
The proposed method constructs context-gloss pairs and utilizes BERT to treat WSD as a sentence-pair classification problem, leading to state-of-the-art performance.
